description: Manage subnets in AWS virtual private clouds.

parameters.name: access_key
parameters.description: AWS access key ID. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_ACCESS_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The aws_access_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_access_key_id alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: assign_instances_ipv6
parameters.description: Whether instances launched into the subnet should default to being automatically assigned an IPv6 address. If assign_instances_ipv6=true, ipv6_cidr must also be specified. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: aws_ca_bundle
parameters.description: The location of a CA Bundle to use when validating SSL certificates. The AWS_CA_BUNDLE environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: aws_config
parameters.description: A dictionary to modify the botocore configuration. Parameters can be found in the AWS documentation https://botocore.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/reference/config.html#botocore.config.Config.

parameters.name: az
parameters.description: The availability zone for the subnet. Required if outpost_arn is set.

parameters.name: cidr
parameters.description: The CIDR block for the subnet. E.g. 192.0.2.0/24.

parameters.name: debug_botocore_endpoint_logs
parameters.description: Use a botocore.endpoint logger to parse the unique (rather than total) "resource:action" API calls made during a task, outputing the set to the resource_actions key in the task results. Use the aws_resource_action callback to output to total list made during a playbook. The ANSIBLE_DEBUG_BOTOCORE_LOGS environment variable may also be used. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: endpoint_url
parameters.description: URL to connect to instead of the default AWS endpoints. While this can be used to connection to other AWS-compatible services the amazon.aws and community.aws collections are only tested against AWS. The AWS_URL environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: ipv6_cidr
parameters.description: The IPv6 CIDR block for the subnet. The VPC must have a /56 block assigned and this value must be a valid IPv6 /64 that falls in the VPC range. Required if assign_instances_ipv6=true Default: ""

parameters.name: map_public
parameters.description: Whether instances launched into the subnet should default to being assigned public IP address. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: outpost_arn
parameters.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Outpost. If set, allows to create subnet in an Outpost. If outpost_arn is set, az must also be specified. Default: ""

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: A named AWS profile to use for authentication. See the AWS documentation for more information about named profiles https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-profiles.html. The AWS_PROFILE environment variable may also be used. The profile option is mutually exclusive with the aws_access_key, aws_secret_key and session_token options.

parameters.name: purge_tags
parameters.description: If purge_tags=true and tags is set, existing tags will be purged from the resource to match exactly what is defined by tags parameter. If the tags parameter is not set then tags will not be modified, even if purge_tags=True. Tag keys beginning with aws: are reserved by Amazon and can not be modified. As such they will be ignored for the purposes of the purge_tags parameter. See the Amazon documentation for more information https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws_tagging.html#tag-conventions. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The AWS region to use. For global services such as IAM, Route53 and CloudFront, region is ignored. The AWS_REGION environment variable may also be used. See the Amazon AWS documentation for more information http://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#ec2_region.

parameters.name: secret_key
parameters.description: AWS secret access key. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY or AWS_SECRET_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The secret_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_secret_access_key alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: session_token
parameters.description: AWS STS session token for use with temporary credentials. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SESSION_TOKEN environment variable may also be used. The session_token and profile options are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Create or remove the subnet. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: A dictionary representing the tags to be applied to the resource. If the tags parameter is not set then tags will not be modified.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: When set to false, SSL certificates will not be validated for communication with the AWS APIs. Setting validate_certs=false is strongly discouraged, as an alternative, consider setting aws_ca_bundle instead. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: vpc_id
parameters.description: -”VPC ID of the VPC in which to create or delete the subnet.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Whether to wait for changes to complete. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: wait_timeout
parameters.description: Number of seconds to wait for changes to complete Ignored unless wait=true. Default: 300

examples:
# Note: These examples do not set authentication details, see the AWS Guide for details.

- name: Create subnet for database servers
  amazon.aws.ec2_vpc_subnet:
    state: present
    vpc_id: vpc-123456
    cidr: 10.0.1.16/28
    tags:
      Name: Database Subnet
  register: database_subnet

- name: Remove subnet for database servers
  amazon.aws.ec2_vpc_subnet:
    state: absent
    vpc_id: vpc-123456
    cidr: 10.0.1.16/28

- name: Create subnet with IPv6 block assigned
  amazon.aws.ec2_vpc_subnet:
    state: present
    vpc_id: vpc-123456
    cidr: 10.1.100.0/24
    ipv6_cidr: 2001:db8:0:102::/64

- name: Remove IPv6 block assigned to subnet
  amazon.aws.ec2_vpc_subnet:
    state: present
    vpc_id: vpc-123456
    cidr: 10.1.100.0/24
    ipv6_cidr: ''

return_values.name: subnet
return_values.description: Dictionary of subnet values. Returned: state=present

return_values.name: assign_ipv6_address_on_creation
return_values.description: Whether IPv6 address is auto-assigned to new instances. Returned: state=present Sample: false

return_values.name: availability_zone
return_values.description: Availability zone of the Subnet. Returned: state=present Sample: "us-east-1a"

return_values.name: availability_zone_id
return_values.description: The AZ ID of the subnet. Returned: state=present Sample: "use1-az6"

return_values.name: available_ip_address_count
return_values.description: Number of available IPv4 addresses. Returned: state=present Sample: "251"

return_values.name: cidr_block
return_values.description: The IPv4 CIDR of the Subnet. Returned: state=present Sample: "10.0.0.0/16"

return_values.name: default_for_az
return_values.description: Indicates whether this is the default Subnet for this Availability Zone. Returned: state=present Sample: false

return_values.name: enable_dns64
return_values.description: Indicates whether DNS queries made should return synthetic IPv6 addresses for IPv4-only destinations. Returned: success Sample: false

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: Subnet resource id. Returned: state=present Sample: "subnet-b883b2c4"

return_values.name: ipv6_association_id
return_values.description: The IPv6 association ID for the currently associated CIDR. Returned: state=present Sample: "subnet-cidr-assoc-b85c74d2"

return_values.name: ipv6_cidr_block
return_values.description: The IPv6 CIDR block actively associated with the Subnet. Returned: state=present Sample: "2001:db8:0:102::/64"

return_values.name: ipv6_cidr_block_association_set
return_values.description: An array of IPv6 cidr block association set information. Returned: state=present

return_values.name: association_id
return_values.description: The association ID. Returned: always

return_values.name: ipv6_cidr_block_state
return_values.description: A hash/dict that contains a single item. The state of the cidr block association. Returned: always

return_values.name: state
return_values.description: The CIDR block association state. Returned: always

return_values.name: ipv6_native
return_values.description: Indicates whether this is an IPv6 only subnet. Returned: success Sample: false

return_values.name: map_customer_owned_ip_on_launch
return_values.description: Indicates whether a network interface receives a customer-owned IPv4 address. Returned: success Sample: "flase"

return_values.name: map_public_ip_on_launch
return_values.description: Whether public IP is auto-assigned to new instances. Returned: state=present Sample: false

return_values.name: owner_id
return_values.description: The ID of the Amazon Web Services account that owns the subnet. Returned: success Sample: "12344567"

return_values.name: private_dns_name_options_on_launch
return_values.description: The type of hostnames to assign to instances in the subnet at launch. An instance hostname is based on the IPv4 address or ID of the instance. Returned: success Sample: {"enable_resource_name_dns_a_record": false, "enable_resource_name_dns_aaaa_record": false, "hostname_type": "ip-name"}

return_values.name: subnet_arn
return_values.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the subnet. Returned: success Sample: "arn:aws:ec2:us-east-1:xxx:subnet/subnet-xxx"

return_values.name: tags
return_values.description: Tags attached to the Subnet, includes name. Returned: state=present Sample: {"Name": "My Subnet", "env": "staging"}

return_values.name: vpc_id
return_values.description: The id of the VPC where this Subnet exists. Returned: state=present Sample: "vpc-67236184"
